verdict.rationale: Fin has its own documented programmatic surfaces: a Fin Agent API (Ask Fin, Run a procedure, Escalate, Discover capabilities), a Fin API platform for answer generation and knowledge retrieval, SDK content-import calls, and a Fin CLI for configuration. However, the orchestration endpoints are Preview-only, and nothing shows that UI-managed features like Guidance, Procedures authoring, testing, Insights, Monitors or escalation rules can be managed through the API. Missing for 10: documented API coverage for configuring Procedures, Guidance, testing, analytics and escalation rules; GA (non-preview) status of the orchestration endpoints; a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404); independent confirmation of UI–API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Fin can be accessed programmatically via an API.
The new orchestration endpoints — Discover capabilities, Ask Fin, Run a procedure, and Escalate to a human — are currently available in the Preview API version only.
The Fin API platform includes APIs for answer generation and knowledge retrieval, available as a set or independently.
Point your AI coding Agent at the Fin CLI to set up Fin on your website and configure your Intercom helpdesk
